activity_text: Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, Anti-HIV, Anti-MRSA, anti-sepsis, Wound healing
comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (76.92%) to parent peptide BmKn2 I=R: 23%, L=F=K: 15%. Activity: active against Gram- E. coli AB94012 or ATCC 25922 (MIC 6.25-25 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa AB93066 or A092994 like 5 strains (MIC 25-100 ug/ml), Gram+ S. aureus AB94004 or ATCC 25923 or MRSA (MIC 3.13 ug/ml), S. epidermidis (MIC 2.5-5.0 ug/ml), E. faecalis (MIC 5-10 ug/ml), E. faecium (MIC 5 ug/ml), B. subtilis AB91021 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), B. thuringiensis AB92037 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml), and M. luteus AB93113 (MIC 6.25 ug/ml). Structure: random coil in water and become helical in 30% or 70% TFE. In vitro toxicity: human RBC: HC50 >100 ug/ml, less hemo.lytic. Animal model:mouse: skin infected with S. aureus: showed wound healing effect ( Cao et al., 2012).
